title: How To Use Colorways | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
Learn all about CLO's updated Colorway with our Global UX Designer. Review the foundations and the updates on the advance options of Colorway and how it can apply to your workflow.  

Chapters:

Foundations
00:39 UI / Layout 
04:45 Zfab Breakdown
09:45 Adding Fabric 

Colorway
17:19 Simple Add
18:15 Changing Basic Properties 
21:25 Advanced Add
26:07 UI Hints/ Guidance 
28:22 All Properties 
36:22 Linking & Unlinking 
39:03 Changing Fabrics (Open Select) 
40:34 Changing Fabrics (Drag & Drop Options)
43:36 Hiding Graphics 

43:58 Colorway Quick Refresher 

Exporting 
47:28 Save Image / Line sheet
